extreme.why: CoM 0.19 m above the axle (0.135 m on CAD/) and 4.6 kg: more roll in hard turns. Measured 5.2 deg nominal; limit 1.5x like the CAD/ limits

slalom.why: taller, heavier robot as for extreme. Measured 2.6 deg nominal; limit 1.5x

fall_fwd.why: 14 N does not topple this robot; scaled with mass (50 N at 4.4 kg) to the 4.6 kg XGT-battery robot. Clearly unrecoverable, as the scenario intends

fall_back.why: -12 N does not topple this robot; -35 N at 4.4 kg scaled with mass to 4.6 kg

fall_trip.why: 3 N m does not trip this robot; 7 N m at 4.4 kg scaled with mass to 4.6 kg

fast_turn.why: taller robot as for extreme (CoM 0.19 m above the axle). Measured 3.0-3.1 deg nominal at 6 kg; limit 1.5x
